stem.text: Species X is a single-celled eukaryote.
Species X has been genetically modified to produce penicillin, which does not harm the cell walls of species X.
What may be concluded from this information?

items: The cell walls of species X are chemically different from those of bacteria.
The cell walls of species X are made of peptidoglycan.
The cell walls of species X are made of cellulose.
